title: Guess the Number
statement:
In this problem, there is a hidden integer $x$ such that $1 \le x \le 10^6$. You can make up to $50$ queries.
In each query, you can ask if $x \ge y$. The grader will answer "YES" or "NO".
inputFormat: This is an interactive problem. You do not read the size of the input.
outputFormat: To guess the number, print "! x" and terminate your program.
